verdict.rationale: vLLM is a self-hosted inference engine that users install (pip/uv, Docker) and run on their own hardware. It has no vendor-hosted storage, so offering a region or residency selector is outside this product type. Where data lives depends entirely on where the user deploys it, which is a user-side arrangement rather than a vLLM capability, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
